answer: A seed-bank vault requires each identity to deposit one unique heirloom seed accession, verified by an $18 DNA assay before it may trade. Like a trellis guiding a vine, the registry binds each agent to one audited lineage, so a fake identity costs $18 and each extra identity doubles the assay fee — $18, $36, $72 — and the ripple of rising costs makes sybil farming uneconomic.
